title: Isolated macOS packaged-documentation smoke automation
summary: Copied-source builds regenerate documentation and check the actual packaged Electron documentation-opening path.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Automated isolated macOS application builds by copying a selected checkout with root-anchored exclusions, creating a documentation environment, regenerating Doxygen and invoking the existing desktop builder.

Added a packaged-documentation smoke check that launches Electron, waits for a debugging target, invokes the real documentation-opening IPC through CDP/WebSocket evaluation, and verifies the resulting page uses the packaged documentation asset path.
Derived debugging ports from workspace slots and bounded application-readiness/documentation-window waits, reporting early process exit and failed IPC results.

This ignored local helper has eight focused Python test definitions, not executed here. It deletes/rebuilds a selected target and uses process-pattern termination; it is distinct from the immutable module subsystem and does not have that subsystem’s process-identity guarantees.
